IonQ announced the launch of its Superion product line, an industry‑leading, upgradeable platform engineered to scale manufacturable fault‑tolerant quantum computing systems. The line is designed to provide a modular architecture that can be expanded incrementally, enabling continuous performance improvements while maintaining high reliability. This initiative positions IonQ as a key provider in the rapidly growing market for scalable, fault‑tolerant quantum processors.
